name: password-input
title: Password Input
description: A password input field with a visibility toggle button and correct autocomplete handling.

props.name: autoComplete
props.description: The autocomplete attribute for the password input.

props.name: defaultVisible
props.description: The default visibility of the password input.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the password input is disabled.

props.name: getRootNode
props.description: A root node to correctly resolve document in custom environments. E.x.: Iframes, Electron.

props.name: ids
props.description: The ids of the password input parts

props.name: ignorePasswordManagers
props.description:
When `true`, the input will ignore password managers.

**Only works for the following password managers**
- 1Password, LastPass, Bitwarden, Dashlane, Proton Pass

props.name: invalid
props.description: The invalid state of the password input.

props.name: name
props.description: The name of the password input.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Whether the password input is read only.

props.name: required
props.description: Whether the password input is required.

props.name: visible
props.description: Whether the password input is visible.

events.name: onVisibilityChange
events.description: Function called when the visibility changes.

examples.title: Basic
examples.source:
import PasswordInput from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/password-input/password-input.marko";

<PasswordInput label="Password" placeholder="Enter your password" class="w-[320px]"/>
examples.description: A labeled password input with a visibility toggle button.

examples.title: New password
examples.source:
import PasswordInput from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/password-input/password-input.marko";

<PasswordInput
  label="New password"
  placeholder="Create a password"
  name="new-password"
  autoComplete="new-password"
  class="w-[320px]"
/>
examples.description: Pass `autoComplete="new-password"` so browsers offer a generated password instead of an existing one.

examples.title: Disabled
examples.source:
import PasswordInput from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/password-input/password-input.marko";

<PasswordInput label="Password" value="hunter2" disabled class="w-[320px]"/>
examples.description: A disabled password input ignores pointer input and is skipped by the tab order.

examples.title: Invalid
examples.source:
import PasswordInput from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/password-input/password-input.marko";

<PasswordInput label="Password" value="short" invalid class="w-[320px]"/>
examples.description: Pass `invalid` to mark the field as failing validation.

examples.title: Controlled
examples.source:
import PasswordInput from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/password-input/password-input.marko";
visible: ${String(visible)} { visible = next; } class="w-[320px]" />
examples.description: Zag machines are controlled: a `visible` prop without a change handler never moves. Pair it with `visibleChange`, or use Marko's bind shorthand `visible:=state`.
